text:
Jo (Design): dropping a tiny prototype for a 'token peek' micro-bar that sits over the composer on small screens. idea: show total tokens, a compact per-message token badge, and a tiny scrubber you can drag to inspect recent chunks. mock: https://figma.redwood/proto/token-peek-mini-scrubber :mag:

Lina (Product): neat. quick q: when streaming, does scrubbing pause the stream? what happens if a user tries to drag while generation is active?

Jo (Design): plan: scrubbing enters an inspection mode (pauses autoscroll but doesn't cancel generation). tapping the scrubber will jump focus to the message chunk preview. dragging should be lightweight — we only show estimated token cost per sample.

Ravi (Eng): implementation notes: streaming text keeps updating; inspection mode overlays a snapshot of the current token map. avoid cloning huge DOM trees. idea: maintain a small ring buffer of recent chunk metadata {start, end, tokenEstimate} and render from that. stream updates are single-node patches.

Taylor (DevEx): keyboard flows: we need a predictable tab order. proposal: composer -> send -> token-peek -> messages. also add quick actions: `Ctrl+.` opens quick actions, with `I` = Inspect token map, `F` = Freeze generation, `R` = Restart. document these in the command palette.

Noor (A11y): a few accessibility items: 1) token peek should expose `role=region` with `aria-label=\"Token information\"`. 2) scrubber must be operable via arrow keys and announce current sample: e.g., \"chunk 3 of 8, ~24 tokens\". 3) avoid animated color-only indicators; add shape or pattern for contrast.

Jo (Design): good call. we'll make the scrubber keyboard-friendly and ensure the chunk tooltip is sr-only annunciated when focused. microcopy idea for the freeze action: label = `Freeze`  help = `Freeze generation — keep current text and inspect`. Lina, prefer Freeze vs Interrupt vs Stop?

Lina (Product): prefer `Freeze` (verb feels lighter). add a secondary affordance `Restart (from scratch)` for clarity. analytics team asked for distinct event names: `playground.freeze` and `playground.restart`.

Ravi (Eng): edge cases: 1) Freeze must be idempotent if pressed multiple times. 2) Restart should kill the current stream and create a fresh run with identical inputs unless user edits prompt. 3) wire `Freeze` to pause streaming updates to the UI but still let backend finish generation unless we send a cancel signal. we need to decide whether Freeze cancels compute or only UI.

Noor (A11y): if Freeze cancels compute, announce to screen readers: \"Generation frozen; partial output preserved\". if it doesn't cancel, announce: \"UI frozen for inspection; generation continuing in background\". we should pick one behavior and make it explicit.

Taylor (DevEx): my preference: Freeze should be local UI freeze only (no backend cancel) to avoid accidental compute loss. provide a clear secondary control `Abort` if users want to stop compute entirely. map `Esc` to Abort only when composer focused and streaming active. map `Shift+Esc` to Freeze.

Lina (Product): agreed on Freeze = UI-only. add `Abort` (hard stop) for power users. analytics: track `playground.abort` too.

Jo (Design): copy options for the scrubber hover: A) \"Drag to inspect recent response chunks and estimated token cost\" B) \"Inspect recent chunks — drag or use arrow keys\" C) \"View token cost for recent text\" 90% vote for B from me.

Noor (A11y): prefer B as well (short, action-oriented). also ensure the hover text is reachable via keyboard (aria-describedby).

Ravi (Eng): perf checklist: 1) single text node streaming updates, 2) token estimates updated on chunk boundaries (batch at 1s), 3) scrubber gestures debounce 50ms, 4) keep memory for last 20 chunks.

Taylor (DevEx): testing notes: add e2e for keyboard scrubbing, screen-reader narration on freeze/abort, and analytics events. include quick key cheat-sheet in the help modal.

ui-deploy: scheduling rollout: experiment/playground/token-peek-smallscreen -> internal beta 2024-07-05T16:00:00Z :rocket:

Jo (Design): will upload updated frames with the accessible labels and a short gif showing Freeze -> Inspect -> Restart flow. will tag the PR with `ux/compact-token-peek` when ready. :white_check_mark:
